title: Red Hat Security Advisory: xdg-desktop-portal security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-55888) in xdg-desktop-portal allows unauthorized host file access via unvalidated FileChooser filenames. This flaw affects the portal front-end service to flatpak, which exposes D-Bus interfaces for file access and other operations. The issue has been addressed in an update available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.2 Extended Update Support and related products.
